description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amended Gazette Extra Ordinary No. 2234/23 dated 30th June 2021 for the words and Figures after August 15th, 2021 to the words and Figures after October 15th, 2021
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification amending excise rules under the Excise Ordinance. It contains a statutory instrument (Excise Notification No. 09/2021) that modifies previous regulations regarding security features and their management system. While it mentions Basil Rajapaksa as Minister of Finance, this is only in his capacity as the authority making the regulatory amendment, not as a personnel announcement or with detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is regulatory in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
